---
title: "D1 Retention Graph Report"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
data <- read_csv("d1.csv")
```

```{r}
data$creat_date <- as.Date(data$creat_date)
```

## Plot Graph

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = creat_date, y = D1_Retention_percent)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "D1 Retention Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Retention (%)"
  )
```
